description: Four letters between Maria Chabot and Fuller & Evans, Attorneys, Denver, CO, Dec. 1961 to Jan. 1962. Five letters between Maria Chabot and Paul Shwartz, Attorney, Albuquerque, NM, Dec. 1961 to Jan. 1962. Nine letters between Maria Chabot and Rupert M. Ryan, Attorney, Boulder, CO, Jan. 1962 to May 1962 with a photocopy of the Divorce Decree, May 14, 1962 and a carbon copy of the Petition for Divorce, May 1962. An Internal Revenue Service document, "Community Property," and a memorandum from the Colorado Department of Revenue on state residency.
title: Divorce proceedings
